title: Queue
description: Message brokers: is work piling up, are consumers keeping up, are messages lost. RabbitMQ (built-in plugin), Kafka (kafka_exporter), NATS JetStream (nats exporter). Opened for containers labelled container.type=queue.

list.name: New image deployed
list.expr: (count by (name, image) (container_last_seen{name!="", image!=""}) unless count by (name, image) (container_last_seen{name!="", image!=""} offset 10m)) and on (name) (time() - container_start_time_seconds{name!=""} < 120)

panels.title: Running
panels.description: Containers seen by cAdvisor in the last minute.

targets.expr: count(time() - container_last_seen{name=~"$container", name!="", container_label_container_type=~"queue"} < 60) or vector(0)

panels.title: OOM kills (24h)
panels.description: Killed by the kernel for using more memory than the limit.

panels.title: Memory vs limit
panels.description: Highest working set vs memory limit among the containers. Empty when none has a limit.

panels.title: Messages waiting
panels.description: Ready, not yet delivered. Growing = consumers too slow or down.

panels.title: Unacked
panels.description: Delivered, consumer has not confirmed yet. High = slow or stuck consumers.

panels.title: Consumers
panels.description: 0 consumers on a queue = nothing processes it.

panels.title: Time to drain
panels.description: Backlog / ack rate: how long consumers need to empty the queues if no new messages arrive.

panels.title: Messages waiting by queue
panels.description: Steady climb = consumers can't keep up. Saw-tooth = batch consumers (fine).

panels.title: In vs out (msg/s)
panels.description: published above acked for long = backlog grows. Redelivered = consumers failing or crashing.

panels.title: Consumers and consumer utilisation
panels.description: Utilisation under 100% with a backlog = prefetch too low or consumers slow.

panels.title: Dead-lettered and dropped (msg/s)
panels.description: Messages that did not reach a consumer. Unroutable = published to an exchange with no matching queue.

panels.title: Connections and channels
panels.description: Many opened/min = clients reconnect for every message (expensive).

panels.title: Consumer lag by group
panels.description: Messages a consumer group is behind. Growing = consumers too slow.

panels.title: Under-replicated partitions
panels.description: Above 0 = a broker is down or slow; data at risk.

targets.expr: type:~"^(queue)$" container:~"^${container:raw}$" level:(error OR fatal OR panic OR warn) | sort by (_time desc) | limit 300
